RUINA2-FURY.smartDescription: [gold]Little Red[/gold] begins as your [green]ally[/green]. If she lands the killing blow on the [gold]Wolf[/gold], you win. If the [gold]Wolf[/gold] dies by any other means, [gold]Little Red[/gold] heals to full HP, enters an [red]enraged[/red] state, and becomes your [red]enemy[/red].
RUINA2-FURY.title: Fury With No Outlet
RUINA2-BLEED.description: Whenever this creature hits with an attack this turn, it takes damage.
RUINA2-BLEED.smartDescription: Whenever this creature hits with an attack this turn, it takes [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage.
RUINA2-BLEED.title: Bleed
RUINA2-PARALYSIS.description: The next Attack you play this turn deals less damage.
RUINA2-PARALYSIS.smartDescription: The next Attack you play this turn deals [blue]{DamageReduction:diff()}%[/blue] less damage.
RUINA2-PARALYSIS.title: Paralysis
RUINA2-ABSORPTION.smartDescription: [gold]Shrinks[/gold] to a lower [gold]Stage[/gold] on death. [gold]Grows[/gold] to a higher [gold]Stage[/gold] when at full HP.
RUINA2-ABSORPTION.title: Absorption
RUINA2-WARM_HEART.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, you gain {Amount:energyIcons()}. At the end of this creature's turn, it gains [gold]Strength[/gold] equal to your unspent [gold]Energy[/gold] (max [blue]{StrengthCap:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] per turn).
RUINA2-WARM_HEART.title: Warm Heart
RUINA2-HUNTER.smartDescription: The next time this creature is below [blue]{HPThreshold:diff()}%[/blue] HP at the end of its turn, it gains [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{Intangible:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold].
RUINA2-HUNTER.title: Hunter in the Dark
RUINA2-OBLIVION.title: Oblivion
RUINA2-STEAL.smartDescription: On death, you draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] less {Amount:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
RUINA2-STEAL.title: Steal or be Stolen
RUINA2-DRAW_REDUCTION.smartDescription: Draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] less {Amount:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
RUINA2-DRAW_REDUCTION.title: Draw Reduction
RUINA2-WORTHLESS.smartDescription: If this creature Attacks and fails to deal unblocked attack damage, it [red]dies[/red].
RUINA2-WORTHLESS.title: Worthless
RUINA2-DESPAIR.smartDescription: Whenever a minion dies, this creature loses [blue]{Amount}[/blue] HP.
RUINA2-DESPAIR.title: Despair
RUINA2-ROAD.title: Road of the King
RUINA2-BLISS.smartDescription: On death, add a [gold]Fragment of Bliss[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
RUINA2-BLISS.title: Moment of Bliss
RUINA2-HYSTERIA.smartDescription:
Whenever you play [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Attacks[/gold] in a single turn, you gain [blue]{WeakPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold]. 
Whenever you play [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Skills[/gold] in a single turn, you gain [blue]{FrailPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Frail[/gold].
The first time this effect triggers this combat, this enemy will use a [gold]strong debuff[/gold] next turn.
RUINA2-HYSTERIA.title: Hysteria
